implementation: Own-profile loading failures are stored separately from workspace errors. Profile loading and load errors are surfaced as accessible live regions, matching the web profile page's loading/error states. A successful repeat request clears the prior load error and restores the profile.

checks.name: Profile load failure is isolated and retry recovers
checks.command: flutter test test/app_state_test.dart --plain-name "keeps profile load errors separate and clears them on retry"
checks.observation: Failure populates profileLoadError without setting the general workspace error; a subsequent successful refresh clears it and restores the profile.

checks.name: Profile loading is announced as a live region
checks.command: flutter test test/profile_screen_test.dart --plain-name "announces profile loading status"
checks.observation: Loading copy is visible and carries the semantics liveRegion flag.

checks.name: Profile load error is announced and hides unavailable form
checks.command: flutter test test/profile_screen_test.dart --plain-name "announces profile loading errors accessibly"
checks.observation: Error copy is visible as a live region, and profile mutation controls are not shown when no profile could be loaded.

remaining: Physical platform and matched-screen visual acceptance for profile remains open in the parity checklist.
